content.article: At Longfu88, new players meet the Casino Welcome Bonus first: a match of 188% with €2,088 as the cap, plus 18 Free Spins. Deposit plus bonus must be played through 25 times, and spin winnings 40 times. Whoever wants the Longfu bonus finds below reloads, free spins, crypto and live deals, cashback, the VIP program, the rewards area and sports promotions. Only players who are 18 years or older may use anything at Longfu88, and the readers meant are from Singapore.

Longfu88 Bonus Types and Families

Five families group what Longfu88 promotes, and each named offer sits in one of them below, without amounts.

  • Returns on play (cashback and rebates): Casino Weekly Cashback with Live Casino Cashback, plus the Unlimited Casino Rebate
  • Rewards area: Bonus Crab and further game-like features
  • Welcome offers (three): Live Casino Welcome Bonus, Casino Crypto Welcome Bonus and, as the main one, Casino Welcome Bonus
  • Sports betting: Sport First Deposit Bonus along with further sports bonuses
  • Reloads: Casino Weekend Reload together with Casino Weekly Reload

Conditions belong to the single offer, not to its family, while My Bonuses handles the activation of each offer.

The Main Offer and Its Two Alternatives

Leading the welcome offers is the Longfu88 welcome bonus, which goes under the name Casino Welcome Bonus. What rewards the first qualifying deposit is a 188% match plus 18 Free Spins, and the match tops out at €2,088. Newly registered players are the target, one welcome offer is granted per account, and €50 is the least that the first deposit can be. Two alternatives are listed at Longfu88 as well. Of the two, the Live Casino Welcome Bonus stops at €888 on a 125% match, whereas the Casino Crypto Welcome Bonus stops at 2,888 USDT on a 188% match. Between the main bonus and the crypto one, the first deposit goes to either.

How to Claim the Casino Welcome Bonus

Activation must precede play, so four steps in this order lead to the Casino Welcome Bonus, here at Longfu88:

  1. Register, filling in the personal data the casino requests.
  2. Deposit the first qualifying amount.
  3. In My Bonuses, switch the Casino Welcome Bonus on, which must be done ahead of any wager.
  4. Wager on eligible casino games until the requirement is met, before expiry.

A period of 10 days from activation is the validity, and the wagering has to fit into it.

Wagering and Rules of the Welcome Bonus

What the Casino Welcome Bonus demands is collected here. Two separate wagering requirements exist: one covers the deposit and the bonus taken together, the other covers winnings from Free Spins.

Item Detail
Main wagering Deposit and bonus amount, played through 25 times
Free Spins Winnings, played through 40 times
Time limit 10 days counted from activation
Stake limit €22.5 on each spin
Cashout cap 5x, counted on the initial bonus amount

Longfu88 attaches four rules that can cost a player the bonus. Neteller and Skrill deposits do not qualify. Two promotional bonuses cannot run side by side. A withdrawal requested in advance of the claim, or in the course of the bonus, may void eligibility. Cancellation of the promotion forfeits the bonus funds and any unconverted promotional winnings.

Is There a Promo Code at All?

Nothing in the brand information names a Longfu88 promo code, so a player at Longfu88 claims offers without one. Offers are activated in the My Bonuses area instead. For the Casino Welcome Bonus it must happen earlier than the first wager, and for the others once eligibility and the deposit conditions are fulfilled. Getting activation right matters most for the welcome offer, which demands it before any bet.

Minimum Deposit of Every Offer at a Glance

Minimums at Longfu88 vary by offer and by deposit currency, as the crypto offers are set in USDT. The table runs from the lowest amount to the highest.

Minimum deposit Offers
€20 Pumpkin Bonanza, listed as Casino Trick or Treat
20 USDT Casino Weekly Crypto Reload and Casino Weekend Crypto Reload
€30 Live Casino Welcome Bonus, Casino Weekly Reload and the One-Day Reload Special of Casino Double Fortune
€50 Casino Weekend Reload and Casino Welcome Bonus
50 USDT Crypto offer: Casino Crypto Welcome Bonus

Neteller or Skrill deposits cannot be used for claiming the Casino Welcome Bonus. The overall minimum deposit of the casino differs from what an offer requires, which makes the offer's own figure the one that counts.

Reload Bonuses: Weekly, Weekend and One-Day

Four reload offers at Longfu88 target repeat deposits during weekdays and over weekends, and they differ in reward, minimum and wagering.

Offer Minimum Reward Wagering
One-Day Reload Special of Casino Double Fortune from €30 50% match with a €500 ceiling Deposit plus bonus 30x
Casino Weekend Reload from €50 50 Free Spins, plus a maximum of €3,360 Deposit plus bonus 30x, Free Spins winnings 40x
Casino Weekend Crypto Reload from 20 USDT a 75% match, maximum 750 USDT, with 100 Free Spins added Deposit plus bonus 30x, Free Spins winnings 40x
Casino Weekly Crypto Reload from 20 USDT 60% match, maximum 1,000 USDT Deposit plus bonus 30x

Validity is 7 days for the weekly and weekend offers, and the one-day special ends after 24 hours. No other active casino bonus may be combined with a reload. A stake of up to €5 per spin is the limit while bonus funds are being wagered.

Free Spins: Weekly Reload and Seasonal Offers

Three sources supply free spins at Longfu88, each with a wagering rule of its own. The Casino Weekly Reload carries 50 Free Spins, tied to a €30 minimum deposit and valid for 7 days, and 40x applies to their winnings. Around the season, the Pumpkin Bonanza, listed as Casino Trick or Treat, hands out up to 100 Free Spins against a €20 deposit under the same 40x condition. The welcome bonus is the third source, with 18 Free Spins and, again, 40x on winnings.

Crypto Welcome and Reload Offers with USDT

A first crypto deposit is served at Longfu88 by the Casino Crypto Welcome Bonus: a 188% match, a 2,888 USDT ceiling and a 50 USDT minimum deposit. Deposit plus bonus has to be wagered 40 times, the offer lasts 10 days, and each spin may carry a bonus wager of at most 5 USDT. The other option for the first deposit is the Casino Welcome Bonus.

Offer Wagering Reward Minimum
Casino Weekly Crypto Reload Deposit plus bonus 30x 60% match, maximum 1,000 USDT from 20 USDT
Casino Weekend Crypto Reload Deposit plus bonus 30x, Free Spins winnings 40x 100 Free Spins plus 75% up to 750 USDT from 20 USDT

Players can deposit with ETH, BTC, USDT, USDC, XRP, LTC and BCH.

Offers for Live Dealer Games

Three offers at Longfu88 serve live dealer play. First, the Live Casino Welcome Bonus, aimed at new players who start with live games. Terms: 125% up to €888, a €30 minimum on the first qualifying deposit, 30x wagering of deposit plus bonus, validity of 7 days and a maximum bet of €25. Second, the Live Casino Cashback, which refunds 25% up to €850 and applies 10x wagering to the credited cashback. Third, the Unlimited Live Casino Rebate, fixed at 1.0%.

Seasonal and Verification Campaigns

This list may change, and the promotions page of Longfu88 shows the current campaigns. The Pumpkin Bonanza, listed as Casino Trick or Treat, offers a maximum of 100 Free Spins on a €20 minimum deposit, valid 7 days, with 40x on the spin winnings. Players who complete the requested account verification get a €10 bonus credit in the Casino Dragon Quest campaign, called Get Verified and Get Extra! It needs 30x wagering on the credit and a €20 deposit, with a stake of at most €5 per spin.

Cashback: Weekly, Live and by VIP Level

Longfu88 gives back up to 10% of the net casino losses of a week through the Casino Weekly Cashback, limited to €6,988. Each week begins at Monday 00:00 UTC, with Sunday 23:59 UTC as the finish. Taking part means opting in, which covers a four-week cycle, and active accounts can renew it automatically. €4.5 is the minimum cashback. Wagering of 10x on the cashback applies ahead of a withdrawal. The percentage depends on the VIP tier shown in the table, and the section on the VIP Program further down covers the reward levels. Separately, 25% is returned by the Live Casino Cashback, capped at €850, with the credited sum wagered 10x.

Tier Cashback
VIP Bronze 2% (up to €1,888)
VIP Silver 4% (up to €2,388)
VIP Gold 6% (up to €2,988)
VIP Platinum 8% (up to €3,988)
VIP Diamond 10% (up to €6,988)

Unlimited Rebates

An unlimited rebate pays out a portion of the real-money bets settled in a game category, as long as they qualify. The rates at Longfu88 are listed below.

Share Rebate type
1.0% Unlimited Live Casino Rebate and Unlimited Lottery Rebate
0.9% Unlimited Casino Rebate
0.8% Unlimited P2P Rebate

The rebate is credited to the rewards balance every day, and 1x wagering applies to what has been credited.

VIP Program Levels and Points

VIP points are earned at Longfu88 by playing eligible games for real money, and collecting them reaches 25 numbered reward levels. Five tiers form the VIP Program, starting at Bronze and moving on to Silver, then Gold, then Platinum, with Diamond at the top. The table picks five of the levels: level 1 requires one point and level 25 requires 5500.

Level Points needed Reward
25 5500 €980
15 2100 €392
10 700 €147
5 70 €24.5
1 1 €9.8

Higher withdrawal limits, personalised offers and VIP cashback come on top, and eligible high tiers also get a personal VIP manager. VIP levels and currencies may carry different reward and withdrawal limits.

Rewards Area: Crab, Wheel, Challenges and Shop

The rewards area of Longfu88 adds game-like features to the bonuses, and Coins gathered there are spent in its own shop.

  • Bonus Crab: a crab reward is opened by a qualifying pick
  • Wheel of Fortune: turning the prize wheel costs some Coins or an eligible spin
  • Challenges: completing qualifying gambling tasks pays out the rewards that are listed
  • Collections: campaign items are collected through qualifying activity
  • Coin Shop: Coins earned are exchanged for reward items, as well as bonus credits that reach €4,500

Sportsbook Offers and Qualifying Odds

Longfu88 keeps a separate bonus set for sports betting. Its four deposit offers share one wagering rule, which is 8x the deposit plus bonus.

Offer Reward and minimum
Sport Weekend Reload Bonus After a €50 deposit: 50% up to €3,750
Sport Crypto Welcome Bonus After a 20 USDT deposit: 100% up to 200 USDT
Sport First Deposit Bonus After a €50 deposit: 100% up to €1,888
Sport Weekly Reload Bonus After a €50 deposit: 50% up to €2,500

Qualification matters for wagering on a sports bonus. Odds of 2.00 or higher qualify for a single bet, while 1.50 or higher is required on every accumulator selection, and bets that are voided or cashed out are excluded. The Sport First Deposit Bonus remains valid for 30 days. Besides these, the Sports Cashback returns 10% of eligible sports net losses, up to a maximum of €2,500, and the Parlay Boost makes the winnings of qualifying accumulators grow by up to 100%.

Sports Extras: Early Payout and Parlay Boost

Three more sports offers at Longfu88 are not deposit bonuses at all.

  • 2 Goals Ahead - Early Payout: a two-goal lead for the selected team triggers early settlement of eligible football bets, and the markets that qualify are the participating pre-match match-winner ones
  • Parlay Boost: accumulators with at least 3 legs that qualify see winnings rise, up to 100% more, and no additional bonus wagering is attached to the enhanced winnings after settlement
  • Bet Builder Risk Free: qualifying Bet Builder selections placed pre-match get 50% of the stake returned risk-free, to a maximum of €250. The credited free-bet stake needs 1x wagering and has a validity of 7 days

Documents and Checks Before Payout

Account verification can be required at Longfu88 ahead of any payout of promotional winnings. A withdrawal requested earlier than the claim, or in the middle of an active bonus, can void promotional eligibility. The following documents apply:

  • Payment method ownership, backed by proof
  • Documents covering the origin of funds or wealth, when asked for
  • Photo ID or passport issued by a government
  • Evidence of the residential address

Documents may be submitted for 30 days at most from the request, and once the set is complete, review lasts 10 days at most.

Cashing Out Bonus Winnings Step by Step

Bonus winnings at Longfu88 wait for completed wagering before a withdrawal. Under the Casino Welcome Bonus the payable maximum is the initial bonus amount times five. A payout request ahead of a claim or during an active bonus can void promotional eligibility, and verification may come first. The steps are:

  1. Sign in and head to the cashier of the casino.
  2. Choose Withdrawal, then a supported method.
  3. Give the amount together with the destination bank, wallet or blockchain address.
  4. If the casino asks, go through identity and payment-method verification.
  5. Review the request and send the confirmation.
  6. The casino processes the request, then any bank or network settlement follows.

Glossary of Bonus Words

Several words recur in the bonus rules of Longfu88, and the table explains each with the values of the Casino Welcome Bonus.

Word Meaning
My Bonuses Area where offers get activated
Opt-in Joining the four-week cycle of the Casino Weekly Cashback
Validity 10 days from activation for completing the wagering
Wagering requirement 25 times the deposit plus bonus
Free Spins winnings Wagered separately, 40 times
Maximum bet €22.5 per spin during wagering
Maximum cashout Bonus withdrawals: the limit is 5x the initial bonus amount

Bonus Terms and Responsible Play

The bonuses of Longfu88 may be used by players aged 18 or over only, and gambling belongs only where it is lawful. Reading the wagering, maximum bet and validity before accepting an offer is sensible, since a promotion that is cancelled forfeits the bonus funds and promotional winnings not yet converted. Spotting gambling-related harm is the purpose of self-assessment questions, and the support organisations include GamCare, with Gambling Therapy and Gamblers Anonymous.

Claiming Bonuses on a Phone

Bonuses count among the mobile features of the responsive Longfu88 site, whose pages open in browsers on smartphones and tablets, next to casino games, the sportsbook, signing in, deposits and withdrawals. More on mobile access can be read on the app page.

Checks Before You Claim an Offer

Before a player claims the Casino Welcome Bonus, seven points of the account and deposit at Longfu88 deserve a look, and all seven stem from the terms above.

  • A welcome offer is given once per account, so the claimant must be a newly registered player
  • The first deposit was not made through Neteller or Skrill
  • At least €50 was paid in as the first qualifying deposit
  • Before the first wager, the bonus was activated in My Bonuses
  • No other promotional bonus is running
  • No withdrawal was requested ahead of the claim, and none during the active period of the bonus
  • Payment of promotional winnings may depend on verification

faqs.question: What first deposit does the welcome bonus ask for?
faqs.answer: The Casino Welcome Bonus starts at €50 for the first deposit.

faqs.question: Is any promo code listed for offers at Longfu88?
faqs.answer: None is listed, so the offers are simply activated under My Bonuses.

faqs.question: Can two promotional bonuses be active together?
faqs.answer: No, one promotional bonus at a time is the limit.

faqs.question: Which methods cannot fund the welcome bonus?
faqs.answer: Neither Neteller nor Skrill can be used for it.

faqs.question: What happens when a payout is asked for in advance of the claim, or in the middle of a running bonus?
faqs.answer: Eligibility for the promotion can be voided.

faqs.question: Is verification needed to get promotional winnings paid?
faqs.answer: It may be, since account verification can be required ahead of payment.

faqs.question: How does a player claim the weekly cashback?
faqs.answer: Opting in comes first, for a four-week cycle. After the credit arrives, the amount is activated from My Bonuses.

faqs.question: What does the Coin Shop offer?
faqs.answer: Bonus credits worth up to €4,500, and also reward items.
